posts.title: Shiraz Empire Officially Registered in Kota Samarahan
posts.body: We're proud to announce that Shiraz Empire is now officially registered under the Sarawak Business Names Ordinance (Reg. No. SAM/PAR/044/2025), based at the MARA Business Incubator, Kota Samarahan.

posts.title: Now Serving Greater Kuching
posts.body: Shiraz Empire now offers aircon supply, installation, maintenance and repair across the Kuching-Samarahan corridor — book a free quote today.
